title: The mill's dog
logline: A dog at the mill in 1994, the yard's dog, asleep in sawdust by the green chain's end, a collar with no tag. Every place the strip drew had a dog first. Era I spotting for the sawdust.

panels.composition: A yard dog asleep in a pile of sawdust at the end of a mill's green chain, a collar with no tag, boards stacked behind, black spotting for the sawdust.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, in the Era I manner, heavy black spotting brought back on purpose, a yard dog asleep in a pile of sawdust at the end of a lumber mill's green chain wearing a collar with no tag, stacked boards behind, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Every place had a dog first.
